missing.what_was_said: Zuckerberg said Meta had gotten through the major layoffs. However, reported Q2 headcount still included roughly half of the approximately 10,000 employees affected by the 2023 layoffs; most affected employees would cease to be included by Q3.

Management reported a significant underrun against 2023 budgeted headcount. Hiring had resumed, but much of the hiring originally planned and budgeted for 2023 was expected to occur in 2024, qualifying how to interpret the exceptionally low headcount.

Management reported over 67,300 employees at year-end, down 22% year-over-year but up 2% from Q3 as hiring resumed. This confirmed the final result while showing that headcount had begun increasing again.

promises.label: Make Reels revenue neutral
promises.commitment: Bring the Reels-driven overall revenue headwind to a roughly neutral position over the next 12-18 months.
promises.outcomeSummary: Reels reached overall company ad-revenue neutrality earlier than expected, then became a positive contributor to overall revenue.

missing.what_was_said: Management distinguished overall revenue neutrality from monetization parity: it did not foresee Reels matching Feed or Stories revenue per unit of time anytime soon, but still expected overall revenue neutrality by year-end or early 2024 and a positive contribution thereafter.
Management explicitly reported good progress in Q2 in reducing the Reels revenue headwind and said it expected to reach neutrality by the end of 2023.

Management clarified that Reels had been a revenue headwind for most of 2023 and had only just reached neutrality. It expected Reels to contribute to revenue in 2024 but did not expect to quantify that contribution.

promises.label: Reach one billion Meta AI users
promises.commitment: Make Meta AI the leading personalized AI assistant, reaching more than 1 billion people in 2025.
promises.outcomeSummary: Meta AI exceeded a billion monthly actives in 2025, meeting the reach target; becoming the leading personal AI remained a stated ambition.

missing.what_was_said: Zuckerberg said Meta AI was already used by more people than any other assistant. This distinguishes leadership by user reach from the continuing ambition to build the leading personalized AI experience.

Zuckerberg said improving the models provided a runway to improve engagement and turn Meta AI into a product 'that's leading over time.' Broader product leadership remained forward-looking despite the achieved billion-user milestone.

Zuckerberg described Meta AI powered by Muse Spark as a 'world-class assistant' that led in several areas, including visual understanding, health and shopping. This reported further qualitative progress, but was not a declaration of overall personal-AI leadership.

promises.label: Fund 2026 AI infrastructure expansion
promises.commitment: Invest $115-135 billion in 2026 capital expenditures, including finance-lease principal, supporting Meta Superintelligence Labs and the core business.
promises.outcomeSummary: Meta narrowed 2026 capex guidance to $135-145 billion, including finance-lease principal; reported quarterly capex was $34.91 billion. Full-year completion remained pending.
